# Claude Code for iOS

Run Claude Code natively on your jailbroken iPhone. CLI-only package. This package includes:

- **Node.js 18.20.4** runtime optimized for iOS
- **Claude Code 2.1.112** - Anthropic's AI coding assistant, with plugins/marketplaces/agents (the newest version still distributed as a portable cli.js - see the repo README)
- **System ripgrep** for code search (no bundled macOS binary)

## Features

- Full Claude Code CLI functionality, including plugins, plugin marketplaces, and custom agents
- Login/authentication handled entirely by the official CLI - no bundled OAuth server or credential gate
- Optimized V8 flags for iOS JIT restrictions
- Fixed initial-launch terminal hang on iOS terminal apps
- Run from any terminal (SSH, NewTerm, etc.) - the experimental home-screen app has been removed

## Requirements

- iOS 15.0 or later
- Jailbroken device (Dopamine, palera1n, etc.)
- ~120MB free storage
- zsh, ldid, ripgrep, git

### Run Claude Code
```
claude
```
First run prompts you to log in via `/login`, or run `claude setup-token` for a headless SSH-only login.

### Single Query Mode
```
claude -p "your prompt here"
```

- Upgraded the bundled Claude Code CLI from 2.1.19 to 2.1.112 - plugins, plugin marketplaces, custom agents, skills, and more. The newest version still distributed as a portable cli.js; 2.1.113+ switched to a compiled native binary with no iOS target
- Removed the home-screen app (it was just a broken NewTerm URL-scheme launcher)
- Removed the bundled OAuth/localhost-callback auth flow and the credential gate - login is now entirely the official CLI's job (`/login`, or `claude setup-token` for headless SSH)
- Fixed a terminal hang on first launch on several iOS terminal apps (CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY=1)
- Switched to the system `ripgrep` package instead of the bundled macOS ripgrep binary; added it and `git` as package dependencies
- Rebuilt as a traceable overlay/repack on top of the pinned 2.1.19-1 upstream .deb (see scripts/build-repack.sh in the repo)

- Initial iOS release
- Node.js 18.20.4 with iOS optimizations
- Home screen app launcher
- OAuth and API key authentication
- Rootless jailbreak support (/var/jb)
